questions.prompt: In what month did Pendle hit its all-time high TVL?
questions.explanation: Pendle reached its all-time high (ATH) of $13.4B in September 2025, a significant leap compared to earlier months like August 2021, when it was still establishing its presence in the DeFi space. The timing of this ATH reflects the growing adoption of yield-bearing assets and the increasing interest in tokenizing future yield, which likely contributed to Pendle's rapid growth during that period.

questions.prompt: What share of Pendle's TVL is on its top chain (Ethereum)?
